description: Practical full comparison under a shared-GPU 3–4 hour target. All 16 method variants, full query rows, method-default epochs with validation early stopping (patience 3), one shared train20-fitted retrieval key, and the canonical Object→Goal→Spatial→LIBERO-10 stream order. Remaining order variants are reserved for a seed-0/H25 follow-up on the best two methods.

S.selection_uses: object/goal-only training and spatial query metrics

C.selection_uses: object/goal-only training and spatial query metrics

runtime_estimate.approximate_wall_time: 3.6–3.9 hours for primary matrix; about 10 additional minutes for two non-canonical orders on the best two methods at H=25, seed=0
runtime_estimate.basis: Measured 16-method H=25/seed=0 baseline: 20.27 min total, 76 sec/method; measured canonical sequential order: 64.1 sec/method. Extrapolation: 96 method×seed×horizon cells × (76+64.1) sec = 3.74 hours before early-stop savings. MI resampling lowered from 20/100 to 10/50, and early stopping patience=3 is enabled. Actual duration varies by horizon and shared-GPU contention.
runtime_estimate.uncertainty: Moderate. The 64.1 sec sequential timing is one M0/H25 run; runtime may exceed 4h if other methods or H=10 produce materially slower suite metrics. Run serially to avoid GPU contention.

run_command: cd /work && source env/activate.sh && export XLA_PYTHON_CLIENT_PREALLOCATE=false && python -m skill_moe.skillnet.examples.emergent.light.skill_bench --config skill_moe/skillnet/examples/emergent/light/skill_bench_practical_3h.json

followup_order_sensitivity.notes: Run the two non-canonical order variants on the two leading methods only; retain the same full query rows.
followup_order_sensitivity.run_command_template: cd /work && source env/activate.sh && export XLA_PYTHON_CLIENT_PREALLOCATE=false && python -m skill_moe.skillnet.examples.emergent.light.skill_bench --config skill_moe/skillnet/examples/emergent/light/skill_bench_practical_3h.json --methods <two-selected-methods> --seeds 0 --horizons 25 --sequential-orders libero10_then_spatial random_mixed

protocol_order_definitions.random_mixed: Object → Goal, then interleave Spatial and LIBERO-10 store rows with a fixed seed
